verdict.rationale: Ardent has no documented ongoing free tier. The pricing page offers only a $30 one-time credit on top of a paid base plan plus compute and storage. Scale-to-zero and 'never pay for idle' could stretch that credit for prototyping. A community pricing comment describes a $250/month plan that includes $100 of credit, which reinforces that sustained use requires paying. Missing for 10: a persistent free plan, documented free-tier limits (branches/compute/storage), and evidence the credit covers real prototype workloads.
